icons.name: figma
icons.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE production-ready macOS Dock icon on a genuinely transparent background, square canvas. Image 1 is the approved family preview: match its soft continuous rounded square, shallow bevel, broad subtle upper-left edge highlight, low-key glossy charcoal surface, consistent lighting and restrained relief precisely. Image 2 is the identity source: preserve the actual logo geometry and colors from image 2. Output ONLY the selected icon, not the board, no labels, no extra objects. Front-facing orthographic. Tile occupies 96% of canvas width and height, 2% transparent margin on all sides, no wide padding, no cast shadow outside tile. Smooth continuous corners about 23% width. Opaque tile face with transparent outside, no opaque backdrop or checkerboard. Highlights baked into curved surface, no thick silver rim, no nested frames. Clear at 48px.
Subject: Figma, top-left of approved board: precisely preserve original five-piece Figma mark, red/orange/purple/blue/green on charcoal rounded square. Small shallow relief, original shape proportions.
